crossRefs.note: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.
Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”
But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits…
So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to…

parallels.note: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

translations.web: They had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.
translations.bsb: They also had a few small fish, and Jesus blessed them and ordered that these be set before them as well.
translations.kjv: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before
translations.asv: And they had a few small fishes: and having blessed them, he commanded to set these also before them.
